description: NHFLOW explicit (A 510 2, A 520 2) with dry land next to deep water as a wall (A 541 1): regular waves (T 6 s, kh 1.3, 10 m deep, 24 cells per wave length, 5 layers) normal to a block of dry cells (T 10, 2 m above the water) at x = 196 m. The columns in front of the land keep their non-hydrostatic pressure, the dry cells are dp/dn = 0 walls of the Poisson equation and of the pressure gradients, the normal velocity is mirrored in the divergence: the standing wave has its antinode at the land (gauge at x = 195 m). Without A 541 the land absorbs: reflection 0.78 instead of 0.97.
covers: nhflow_poisson_pcorr: dry column as a wall
nhflow_pjm_corr: rhs, ucorr, upgrad with a wall
